subject: science
skillName: Slowing Wind and Water from Changing the Land

items.prompt:
When wind or water moves soil and changes the land, it is called
A) erosion
B) a fossil
C) weather
D) a habitat

steps: Erosion is wind or water changing the land.

items.prompt:
Plant roots help protect the land by
A) holding the soil in place
B) blowing it away
C) making more wind
D) adding water
items.answer: A) holding the soil in place

steps: Roots hold soil so less is carried away.

items.prompt:
A row of trees that slows the wind is called a
A) windbreak
B) river
C) fossil
D) habitat

steps: A windbreak of trees slows the wind.

items.prompt:
Why compare more than one solution to protect the land?
A) To see which one works best
B) To waste time
C) To make erosion worse
D) There is no reason
items.answer: A) To see which one works best

steps: Comparing shows which solution slows the change most.

items.prompt:
A rock wall helps a beach by
A) blocking the waves so they carry away less sand
B) making bigger waves
C) adding more sand to the waves
D) doing nothing
items.answer: A) blocking the waves so they carry away less sand

steps: The wall blocks waves from moving sand.

items.prompt:
Which better protects sand from blowing away?
A) A windbreak of trees
B) Doing nothing
C) Adding more wind
D) Removing all plants

steps: The windbreak slows the wind so less sand blows away.

items.prompt:
To decide which erosion solution is better, you should
A) compare how much each slows the wind or water from changing the land
B) pick the prettiest
C) pick the cheapest only
D) guess
items.answer: A) compare how much each slows the wind or water from changing the land

steps: The better solution slows the change more.

items.prompt:
Which pair of solutions protects land from erosion?
A) Plant roots holding soil and walls blocking wind or water
B) Removing plants and adding wind
C) Pouring more water and digging
D) Doing nothing twice
items.answer: A) Plant roots holding soil and walls blocking wind or water

steps: Plants hold soil and walls block the wind or water.
